preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2*N for S, N in zip(Ss, Ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of S is exactly 2*N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) for S in Ss)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == '-1' or (len(output[i].split()) == Ns[i] and all(int(j) in range(1, 2*Ns[i]+1) for j in output[i].split())) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a list of N distinct indices in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == '-1') == (not valid_partition(Ss[i], Ns[i])) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is '-1' if and only if a valid partition does not exist.
